attachments.title: Source clinical note
attachments.text:
ENCOUNTER NOTE
Date: 2020-05-15
Provider: Dr. James Okonkwo, MD
Department: Emergency Medicine
Visit Type: ed

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
Infant presents with failure to thrive, persistent vomiting, irritability, and parents report musty odor to urine over the past several weeks.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
The patient with benign familial microcephaly returns for emergency evaluation with failure to thrive, vomiting, and irritability over the past few weeks. The parents also report that the infant's urine has a musty odor.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY:
Active Problem List:
- Benign Familial Microcephaly (diagnosed 2020-01-15)
- Phenylketonuria

MEDICATIONS:
Home Medications:
- Phenylalanine-free amino acid formula 150 mL/kg/day divided every 3-4 hours
- Sapropterin dihydrochloride 20 mg/kg orally daily

ALLERGIES:
No known drug allergies (NKDA)

FAMILY HISTORY:
The infant's family history is unremarkable.

SOCIAL HISTORY:
Smoking: Never. Alcohol: Never. Occupation: None (infant).

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION:
On physical examination, the infant has fair skin, blue eyes, and microcephaly.

LABORATORY DATA:
Laboratory tests reveal elevated phenylalanine levels in the blood. A follow-up urine test confirms the presence of phenylketones.

attachments.text:
ENCOUNTER NOTE
Date: 2020-01-15
Provider: Dr. Maria Rodriguez, MD
Department: Pediatrics
Visit Type: outpatient

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
Parents bring infant for routine 4-month check-up, concerned that his head appears smaller than other infants at daycare.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
The child was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy and delivery. His developmental milestones are appropriate for his age; he is able to sit with support, reaches for objects, and babbles. There is no history of seizures,

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY:
Active Problem List:
- Benign Familial Microcephaly
- Phenylketonuria

MEDICATIONS:
Home Medications:
- Phenylalanine-free amino acid formula 150 mL/kg/day divided every 3-4 hours
- Sapropterin dihydrochloride 20 mg/kg orally daily

ALLERGIES:
No known drug allergies (NKDA)

FAMILY HISTORY:
The family history is noncontributory except for a mention that the paternal grandfather was said to have had a "small head."

SOCIAL HISTORY:
Smoking: Never. Alcohol: Never. Occupation: None (infant).

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION:
On examination, his weight and length are at the 50th percentile, but his head circumference is at the 1st percentile. The anterior fontanelle is appropriately closed, and the rest of the physical examination is unremarkable.
